svg.text: Separated toroids · schematic three-station muon proposal
Issue #105 | DRAFT / PROTOTYPE | fixed 3 T solenoid | no engineering sign-off
Grey: warm coil reservations + HCAL | Violet: retained solenoid | Green / blue / orange: S1 / S2 / S3
BT warm end |z|=6.25 m; ECT warm front/rear |z|=7.05 / 13.55 m; family separation 0.80 m.
Exterior samples: 3.50 T; higher-order subset 3.64 T
Continuous clipped shells are a coverage ceiling. Finite panels, borders, supports and services are not yet placed.
Vacuum field only; conductor peak, nonlinear iron, cryostats, forces and muon reconstruction require subsequent review.
